desk.title: Tickets
desk.setupDescription: Everyone gets a ticket with a QR code, and you scan it at the door to check them in.
desk.settingsDescription: Change how many tickets there are, or pause them for a while.
desk.freeHint: One ticket per person for each date.
desk.paidHint: People pay through Stripe, and the money goes to your club.
desk.priceLocked: The price can't change once someone has a ticket.
desk.capacityRange: Enter a number from 1 to {{maximum}}, or leave it empty for no limit.
desk.pauseHint: Nobody new can get a ticket until you turn this off.
desk.fees: Stripe keeps about 2.9% + 30¢ of each order. Your club gets the rest.
desk.goingNote: Everyone who already said they're going gets a ticket by email.
desk.payoutsNeeded: Set up payouts first, so the money has somewhere to go.
desk.turnedOff: This event no longer has tickets
desk.search: Search by name, email or code
desk.refundDescription: {{name}} gets {{amount}} back on their card, plus an email. Stripe doesn't return its fee to your club.
desk.declineDescription: {{name}} gets an email saying the club declined. Their ticket still works.
desk.cancelledDescription: Every paid ticket is refunded automatically. If some are still valid, Stripe was briefly unreachable: finish the rest here.

refund.promptDescription: Ask {{club}} for a refund. They decide, and you'll get an email either way.
refund.signIn: Sign in to request a refund
refund.title: Ask {{club}} for a refund?
refund.description: If {{club}} agrees, the full price goes back to your card. You'll get an email either way.
refund.notePlaceholder: For example: I can't make the new date.
refund.pending: On {{date}}, you asked {{club}} for a refund. You'll get an email when they decide.
refund.declined: On {{date}}, {{club}} declined your refund request. Your ticket still works.
